title: Coursing and manicuring the table
lead: The rhythm of the meal, and a table that is never allowed to look used.

sections.name: Coursing
know: By course enter every item that way.
The pace ask, then adjust the whole meal.
Together the whole table is served at once.
First bites check back then, then give them space.

sections.name: Manicuring the table
know: Canvas the table never looks used.
Silently clear, then reset everything perfectly straight.
Crumb before dessert, toward a small plate.
Refold a napkin when a guest steps away.

keyPoints.line: ask, then adjust the whole meal.
the whole table is served at once.
check back then, then give them space.

read.where: **Coursing is the rhythm of the meal.** Guests should **never feel rushed or forgotten**.

stops.name: Order and communicate
stops.text: Enter every item **by course**, and tell the kitchen about any **special pacing or timing** request.

stops.name: Ask about pace
stops.text: Ask, then **adjust the whole meal** to the answer.

stops.name: Serve together
stops.text: Present each course to the **whole table at the same moment**, describing every dish. **Clear only when every guest has finished.**

stops.name: Check back early
stops.text: Return **within the first couple of bites**, then give the table **space** to enjoy it.

read.sayIt: Would you like us to linger, or do you have a curtain to catch?

keyPoints.line: clear, then reset everything perfectly straight.
before dessert, toward a small plate.
a napkin when a guest steps away.

read.where: The table is **never allowed to look used**. Tend it **quietly**, between and during courses.

stops.name: Clear and reset
stops.text: Remove used items **silently**, and align the next course’s cutlery, glassware and linens **perfectly straight**.

stops.name: Crumb before dessert
stops.text: With a **crumber or folded napkin** and a **small plate held just below the table edge**, sweep lightly toward the plate.

stops.name: Little details
stops.text: Straighten candles and décor, **refold napkins** when a guest steps away, wipe spills **discreetly**, and replace soiled linen.

sources: The Art of Table Service: 11, Coursing, and 12, Manicuring the Table.

cards.q: When do you clear a course?
cards.answer: Only when every guest has finished
wrong: When most of the table is done
When the next course is ready
cards.source: The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: When do you check back on a course?
cards.answer: Within the first couple of bites
wrong: Only if they wave you over
cards.source: The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.answer: To the whole table at the same moment, describing every dish
wrong: Without a word, to keep it quiet
cards.source: The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: A table has a show to catch. What do you do?
cards.answer: Tell the kitchen and adjust the whole meal’s pace
wrong: Drop the check with the entrées
cards.source: The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.source: The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: How do you crumb a table?
cards.answer: A crumber or folded napkin, sweeping toward a small plate held just below the edge
wrong: Brush the crumbs onto the floor
cards.source: The Art of Table Service (service training module)
